name: final-exact-basic

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: chunk width: 4096 vs 1000 byte-equal (replies and finish reasons)
boot to boot: boot p vs boot g (4096) byte-equal

commands: boot c: PREFILL_CHUNK=1000 ./inkling2mini.sh start; PREFILL_CHUNK=1000 ./inkling2mini.sh bench exactness
python3 bench/tools/exactness.py diff p g; diff p c   (local)
notes: Four fixed prompts (about 16, 521, 2,030 and 8,334 tokens), 128 greedy tokens, solo, one at a time; boots p and g with PREFILL_CHUNK 4096, boot c with 1000; shipping defaults otherwise. prompt_logprobs is refused by this engine, so the comparison rests on the generated ids and finish reasons (the tool says so). A record of this gate is taken first on each boot, before anything that reads the prefix cache.
